gizmo.title: Gorsa of-ilaalaa
gizmo.description: Barataan qabxii yookaan miira isaa irratti akka of-ilaalu gaafadhuu, deebii isaa irratti hundaa'uun gorsa of-sirreessu kenni.

configure.title: Gosa galmee
configure.description: Barataan akkamitti akka jiru akkamitti gabaasa. Lamaanuu sikeelii 0 hanga 4 fayyadamu (qabxii: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; miira: baay'ee gad aanaa=0 hanga baay'ee gaarii=4).

configure.title: Gaaffii
configure.description: Gaaffii barataaf. Gosa galmee sanaaf kan durtii fayyadamuuf duwwaa dhiisi.

configure.title: Gorsawwan
configure.description: Yaada deebii garaagaraaf agarsiifamu. Daangaan jalqabaa wal simu ni fayyadama.
